subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve live connections across reloads

question: Should the persistent WhatsApp channel-runtime owner land after reload and disposal behavior is revalidated on the current merge head?
rationale: The PR repairs an active message-delivery lifecycle and is protected from automated cleanup by both member authorship and the `maintainer` label; a human should confirm the intended process-lifetime ownership contract.
